villageboard.gui.title: Town Hall Board
villageboard.gui.born: Born in the village on day %s, child of %s
villageboard.gui.rename.tooltip: Changes the name shown above their head, like a name tag. Leave empty to remove it.
villageboard.gui.locate.tooltip: Makes the villager glow through walls and shows a compass.
villageboard.gui.lock.tooltip: Freezes the profession: it never changes, even if the workstation disappears. Does not tie them to a specific workstation: use a work contract for that.
villageboard.gui.reset.tooltip: The villager leaves their workstation (freed for others), loses experience, trades and assigned workstation, then looks for a new job.
villageboard.gui.forget.tooltip: For a villager who vanished without a trace. They will be registered again if seen.
villageboard.gui.mode_circle: Provisional territory: %s blocks around the board. %s more stone(s) needed.
villageboard.gui.territory_hint: Each boundary stone becomes a corner of the territory. Hold one to see the borders.
villageboard.gui.show_borders.tooltip: Always show village borders with particles.
villageboard.news.birth_baby_parents: A baby was born, child of %s!
villageboard.news.assigned: Contract signed: %s will work as a %s at the workstation at %s.
villageboard.news.unbound: %s is no longer tied to their %s workstation.
villageboard.contract.empty: Right-click a villager to write them in, then a workstation to assign them to it.
villageboard.contract.next: Right-click a workstation to assign them to it.
villageboard.contract.clear: Sneak + right-click in the air: clear the contract.
villageboard.contract.child: Children cannot sign a work contract.
villageboard.contract.nitwit: A nitwit cannot hold any job.
villageboard.contract.no_village: This villager doesn't live in any village.
villageboard.contract.selected: Contract drawn up for: %s. Right-click their future workstation.
villageboard.contract.not_found: The contract's villager cannot be found (too far or gone).
villageboard.contract.too_far: The villager is more than %s blocks away from this workstation.
villageboard.contract.experienced: %s already works as a %s and has experience: reset their profession from the board first.
villageboard.contract.evicted: %s gives up the spot and will look for another workstation.
villageboard.contract.signed: Contract signed: %s will work as a %s at %s, %s, %s.
villageboard.gui.born_unknown: Born in the village on day %s
villageboard.gui.map_hint: Wheel: zoom · drag: move · funnel: choose which points to show
villageboard.news.housing_full: No free bed left in the village (%s beds): births are on hold.
villageboard.gui.homeless.free_beds: Homeless: hasn't claimed a free bed yet.
villageboard.gui.homeless.no_bed: Homeless: no free bed in the village.
villageboard.gui.no_free_bed: No free bed: no births possible.
villageboard.need.homeless_no_bed.detail: Build at least %s bed(s). As long as no bed is free, no births can happen.
villageboard.need.no_free_bed.detail: The village can't grow: every birth needs a free bed. Add beds to welcome new villagers.
villageboard.need.homeless_free_bed.deta: They should settle in by themselves. If they stay homeless, check that the beds can be reached (door, path).
Build workstations. Suggestions, starting with professions missing from the village:
villageboard.need.unemployed_free_statio: They should take a job soon. To choose who works where, use a work contract.
villageboard.need.free_stations.detail: No unemployed villager to take them: a new villager will be able to.
villageboard.need.no_farmer.detail: Farmers harvest and share the food villagers need to breed. Place a composter near a field.
villageboard.need.no_farmer.detail_compo: A composter exists but nobody works there: an unemployed villager should take it, or use a work contract.
villageboard.need.no_golem.detail: The village is defenceless against zombies and raiders. Build one: 4 iron blocks in a T and a carved pumpkin.
villageboard.need.no_bell.detail: The bell is the villagers' gathering point and rings the alarm during raids.

villageboard.lease.selected: Lease drawn up for: %s. Right-click their future bed.
villageboard.lease.too_far: The villager is more than %s blocks away from this bed.

villageboard.news.home_unbound: %s no longer has an assigned bed.
